title.zh: AWS、Cloudflare、Databricks都跟进Jev，决策模型快成标配了
title.en: AWS、Cloudflare、Databricks都跟进Jev，决策模型快成标配了

current_state.zh: AWS, Cloudflare and Databricks each shipped decision-model offerings — AWS's open-source Strands Decider 2B, Cloudflare's open-sourced Clef and Clef-flash reportedly beating Jev on 3 of 4 task types with far lower latency, and Databricks' ai_decide API/SQL integration — signaling that decision models are becoming standard Agent infrastructure.
